reason: Bladdery means swollen like a bladder, which is inflated.
'Obtusely' says the angle is wide. Plain 'angular' drops that.
Plain negation of clawed.
Fistulose (fistular) means hollow, like a pipe.
Puberulent is minutely pubescent, so glandular-pubescent is close. The 'minute' part is lost, but it is acceptable.
An elongated rectangle is still rectangular. The length is a separate matter.
Exindusiate means without an indusium.
Calyculate means having an epicalyx (calyculus).
The target is a petal spur. Spurs can also be on sepals or the calyx, so the rule fits only petal-like parts.
Aculeolate means with small prickles, which is spiny. The 'small' is lost.
Efarinose means without farina (meal), so not mealy.
Not pitted is the negation of pitted/foveate.
Sheathlike is the same as sheathing.
PO costa is the midrib of a moss phyllid. In flowering plants and ferns, ecostate means no midrib or ribs, so the target does not fit. No better term was found.
Homomallous means all turned to one side, which is secund.
The value term fissured is for bark or axes. 'Cracking' can also mean a fruit or capsule splitting open.
Subcarnose means somewhat fleshy.
Coalesced means grown together, which is connate.
Ebracteolate means without bracteoles.

'Indument' is a noun that names the part, not a statement that it is present. It is already a bearer word (FLOPO_0986003). As a quality it would assert presence wrongly in cases like 'indument absent'.
Acerose means needle-shaped, which is a PATO synonym of subulate.
Pinnately parted is the same as pinnatipartite.
Aphyllous means leafless.
Gradually narrowed describes a taper.
The negation of widened (increased width).
Underdeveloped is about incomplete development (rudimentary, hypoplastic), not only a smaller size.
Weeping means hanging down for branches and crowns. It can also mean exuding, as with resin or sap from bark.
Not obvious means inconspicuous.
Tubiform means tube-shaped, which is tubular.
Concrescent means grown together, which is connate.
Obdeltate means an inverted delta (triangle), which is obtriangular.
Compressed-globose (depressed globose) is oblate.
A denuded stem can be bare of leaves, but it can also be stripped of hairs, bark or scales. It does not always mean leaf absent.
Covered with scales means scaly.
Persisting means persistent, which is non-deciduous.
'Irregularly' contradicts the exact rectangular shape, so the target loses the irregularity.
Pseudoracemose means resembling a raceme.
Vaulted means arched, as in a vault. It may sometimes mean domed.
Laxly arranged means loose.
Cygneous means curved like a swan's neck.
Pouch-shaped is the same as saccate.
Unifoliate on a leaf means a compound leaf with one leaflet, which is unifoliolate.
Withering is a process of drying up, often while the part stays on (marcescent). It does not mean a shriveled shape.
Epaleate means without paleae (chaff scales), as on a composite receptacle. For grasses, a palea is a different part.
The target is a fruit operculum. Operculate also describes seeds, flowers or buds, and moss capsules.
Contracted means narrowed or shortened overall, as in an inflorescence. Constricted means pinched at a point. They are different.
Trichome-covered means covered with hairs.
Lineolate means marked with fine lines, which is striated.
Dimpled means with small pits, which is foveate.
'Sparsely' limits the amount of leaves, and 'leafy' loses it. It would assert a well-leaved part.
